items.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
items.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

items.title: Will AI really destroy humanity? Pioneers who created the tech weigh in
items.description: AI pioneers and "godfathers" have weighed in on Anthropic and OpenAI researcher concerns over existential safety risks around the technology.

items.title: Crypto exchange Binance takes on tradfi by courting rich investors to join its expanded wealth-management platform
items.description: Binance is opening its Capital Connect platform to qualified individual investors for the first time.

items.title: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
items.description: Ukraine's sanctions envoy said Russia could be forced to retreat from the war within six months if its oil revenues are halved.

items.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar
items.description: The reading comes a day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.

items.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
items.description: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

items.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
items.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

items.title: Bond yields are spiking, oil is up — but investors aren’t giving up on stocks
items.description: Rising Treasury yields, geopolitical risk and fresh AI safety concerns are hitting markets, but many investors remain bullish on AI spending and earnings.

items.title: Oil falls as U.S. crude inventories reportedly rise, traders weigh Saudi pipeline closure
items.description: Oil fell Wednesday, as an unexpected increase in U.S. crude inventories outweighed worries over supply disruptions after an Iran-backed attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline.

items.title: Treasury yields hitting 5% may not break markets now — but the clock is ticking
items.description: The 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2007, pushing borrowing costs deeper into territory that could expose some of the financial system's weakest links.

items.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
items.description: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.

items.title: Grab aims for 'next level' in financial services with purchase of buy-now pay-later platform Atome
items.description: Grab is betting $1.49 billion on Atome Financial as it looks to expand its consumer lending business in Southeast Asia.

items.title: Nvidia's Huang diverges with CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI on AI safety at Dreamforce
items.description: Comments from the two tech leaders landed days after Anthropic's Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to slow the pace of model development.

items.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
items.description: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.

items.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
items.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.

items.title: Indonesia's new finance minister faces an uphill battle on fiscal credibility
items.description: Nazara, sworn in hours after Purbaya's dismissal, spent seven years as deputy finance minister and led the ministry's fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019.

items.title: House to vote on bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
items.description: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

items.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar tells CNBC she isn't worried about slowing AI development
items.description: Friar joined CNBC's Jim Cramer on "Mad Money" as the debate over technology's safety risks rages on.

items.title: Why de-dollarization discussions are more talk, less action
items.description: BRICS leaders have asserted the need to use local currencies in intra-BRICS trade to cut dependency on dollar.

items.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
items.description: CBO estimates the Iran war cost the Pentagon $38.1 billion through Aug. 1 and could cost another $2 billion to $3 billion each additional month.
